entries.claim: The new exclusion block interpolates the queried path verbatim into terminal-facing `text` when constructing its suggested git command.
entries.failure_scenario: A repository contains a path such as `src/\u001b]52;c;...\u0007.txt` (or a newline-containing path), and a user queries that exact path through the bare arm. When history simplification excludes a commit, `excludedBlock` emits the control bytes unchanged in `see them with: git log --full-history -- ${path}`. A caller that relays `text` verbatim can therefore execute terminal escape sequences or display forged additional command/output lines.
